purpose: Read-only evidence index for route closure and the conditional native-M10 allocation decision protocol.

inputs.role: historical R/K utility and data-boundary report
vector-label recorder, historical reproduction and observer equivalence
complete train labels and fixed-preference opportunity summary
leave-one-repeat, parent bootstrap and flip stability
finite-communication public candidate and mask evidence

excluded: current finite-communication environment as a substitute for historical M10
future branch outcomes or offline truth as online inputs
new environment execution, model inference, training or budget ledger changes
source_identity_note: The source snapshot is recorded as an external historical input; its full artifact identity remains in the referenced manifest. This decision package does not copy or alter that snapshot.
